notes.title: Planet of Lana reaches 1 million players!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651863/77a2a487d987887e0ab61825031eef6cc4508e8c.png"]

We’re thrilled to announce that Planet of Lana has now been played by 1 million players! 


From the very beginning, Planet of Lana has been a true passion project for all of us at Wishfully. Seeing it connect so deeply with so many of you means the world to us. Your love and support have made it possible for us to continue this journey, now leading us toward the next chapter: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf, arriving next year! We can’t wait to see how the continuation of the story resonates with you. 


Don’t forget to wishlist Planet of Lana II to continue the story next year.


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997230/Planet_of_Lana_II/"][/dynamiclink] 
 Thank you all for playing and sharing your adventures with us!

notes.title: Planet of Lana: Children of the Leaf - Coming in 2026!
notes.content:
The epic saga continues! 

Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf is an ambitious cinematic puzzle adventure, doubling the scale and narrative depth of its predecessor. 

Set for release on all platforms in 2026, this highly anticipated sequel plunges Lana and Mui into a Novo forever altered by the robot invasion. The core of this experience is the enduring strength of their bond, which will be strained across treacherous icy mountains and unearthed ruins. 

As a deeper narrative unfolds, Lana will be compelled to face her inherent destiny and personal demons. But is she ready?

Watch the announcement trailer from the Xbox Showcase:
[previewyoutube=pBSApS3A37U;full][/previewyoutube]

WISHLIST PLANET OF LANA: CHILDREN OF THE LEAF https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997230/Planet_of_Lana_II
Key gameplay features that await you: 

 Unique, Evolved Companion Gameplay: Experience Lana and Mui's profound, evolving bond. Guide Mui with enhanced precision for deep exploration and collaborative puzzle-solving.

 Solve Diverse & Clever Puzzles: Tackle a wider array of physics-based puzzles, including hypnotizing spectacular creatures and controlling new hybrid robots for unique solutions.

 Master Stealth & Wit: Carefully navigate dangerous situations using refined stealth mechanics and tactical wit to outsmart foes.

 Survive Challenging Action Sequences: Use your reflexes and master Lana's new agility with wall jumps, run-slides, and faster movement to survive thrilling, dynamic action sequences.

 Discover an Epic & Deeper Story: Immerse in a longer, more profound sci-fi saga. Confront Lana's own demons and unveil the planet's darkest secrets across stunning, diverse worlds, including new underwater chapters.

 Return of an Acclaimed Composer: Experience Takeshi Furukawa's critically acclaimed score, from the original Planet of Lana. His mesmerizing compositions seamlessly elevate every emotional beat and cinematic moment.
